title: Lucky Lots: Card City Builder — Deal, Build & Raid
description: Deal cards, build houses stage by stage, collect rent, and raid rivals in Lucky Lots: Card City Builder, live now on Google Play.
headline: Deal cards. Build houses. Take the whole street.
subhead: Every hand can bring building materials, Tickets, Tokens, Chips—or a chance to raid a rival. Turn an empty lot into a neighborhood that earns rent while you’re away.

loop.title: Deal
loop.body: Choose Standard, Big, or Mega and turn Tickets into a hand of three.

loop.title: Build
loop.body: Bank the cards and Tokens your active house needs, one construction stage at a time.

loop.title: Defend
loop.body: Protect finished lots with Shields and Guard Dogs when rivals come looking.

loop.title: Grow
loop.body: Collect rent, finish neighborhoods, and move on to your next destination.

features.title: Deal three. Bank what matters.
features.body: Every pull resolves into something useful: build cards, protection, Tickets, Tokens, Chips, jackpots, or mischief.
features.alt: Lucky Lots Card Table showing a three-card deal

features.title: Build every house for real.
features.body: Finish the foundation, walls, windows and doors, roof and chimney, then final touches. Your empty lot changes with every completed stage.
features.alt: A house under construction on My Lot in Lucky Lots

features.title: Raid, protect, and settle the score.
features.body: Attack exposed properties, steal from rival doors, shield your street, and take revenge when an incoming report gives you the chance.
features.alt: Choosing a rival action in Lucky Lots

faq.question: Is Lucky Lots free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Lucky Lots is free to download and play on Android, with optional in-app purchases.

faq.question: Where can I download Lucky Lots?
faq.answer: Lucky Lots: Card City Builder is live on Google Play.

faq.question: What are Tickets, Tokens, and Chips?
faq.answer: Tickets pay for Card Table deals, Tokens pay game prices such as building and repairs, and Chips pay for the Bonus Wheel and mini-games.

faq.question: Are rewarded ads required?
faq.answer: No. Rewarded ads are optional: watch one when you want the offered reward.

faq.question: Can I play in short sessions?
faq.answer: Yes. Deal a few hands, move a house forward, collect rewards, and return when Tickets and rent have recovered.

faq.question: How does saving work?
faq.answer: Progress saves locally first. Cloud sync is available only when the build, service, sign-in, and connection support it, so an unavailable cloud status is not cloud protection.

faq.question: Where can I read the full rules?
faq.answer: Open the How to Play guide for exact rules covering cards, construction, rivals, bonus games, Cities, events, purchases, saves, and safety.
